snippet.title: The Victor Initiative | Special Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the first chapter FOR FREE and wishlist the full game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3296220/The_Victor_Initiative__Chapter_1_Demo/

The Victor Initiative is a first-person horror game about delving into a government research centre and uncovering its secrets. What awaits you in there is anyone's guess...

Music by Jack Rafferty

I use Unity as my game engine.
